explanation: Mathlib has `PrimeSpectrum.isOpen_iff` in `Mathlib/RingTheory/Spectrum/Prime/Topology.lean`, but it characterizes open sets in `PrimeSpectrum R`, not in `MvPolynomial.ZariskiSpace K σ`. Transferring it to this induced topology requires additional results about the point map and zero loci, so it is not a direct duplicate or a one- or two-line special case. The target proof uses the separate local `ZariskiSpace.isClosed_iff`.
